To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the optimized water soaking conditions for GBR production are water with pH 5-6, temperature of 35-37 °C and soaking time of 24 h.
soaking brown rice in water with pH of 6 and temperature 35 °C, for 24 h, produced GBR with improved nutritional composition.
germination of brown rice in water with pH of 6 and temperature 35 °C, for 24 h is the best condition for obtaining GBR with high GABA content and intermediate vitamin B1 and phytic acid contents.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a simple, low cost, and effective process for producing GBR, which can be used to improve the quality and nutritional composition of brown rice for human consumption.
the optimization of germinated brown rice (GRB) production of two popular Thailand rice varieties, KDML 105 and Chainat 15.
an optimized method for producing GBR with higher GABA content, higher vitamin B1, and lower phytic acid (i.e., IP6) contents.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
water soaking of brown rice at 35 °C, pH 6 and 24 h is the best condition to increase GABA, protein, vitamin B1, and IP6 contents and to maintain the texture of the rice.
water soaking of brown rice at 35 °C, for 24 h, with water pH 6, is the best condition for the production of GBR with improved nutritional composition and quality.
the optimized process could be used as a new technology for producing high quality and nutrition of brown rice.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the optimized process for GBR production is simple and can be easily applied in the field.

germination of brown rice in water with pH around neutral, and at temperature of 35-40 °C for 12-24 h, is an efficient process to obtain GBR with improved nutritional composition and texture, which could be further used as raw material for the production of GBR food products with high quality and nutrition.

GBR of KD ML 105 and Chainat 2 varieties with high GABA content, high vitamin B1 and intermediate IP6 contents, and high protein and lipid contents can be obtained by soaking in water with neutral pH and temperature at 35°C for 24 h without additional aeration.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the optimized process for producing GBR can be applied to other rice varieties for improving nutritional quality of GBR.

the GBR of both KDML 105 and Chainat 2 varieties can be obtained by soaking in water with the pH 6 and soaking temperature of 35°C for 24 hours without aeration, which can increase the GABA content by 4 to 5 times, and the vitamin B1 and phytic acid contents by approximately 1.5 times, and decrease the phytate to phytate ratio to 2.3.
GBR of both KDML 105 and Chainat 2 varieties with improved nutritional composition can be produced by soaking in water with a pH of 6 and temperature at 35 °C.
